Welcome to my Engineering Portfolio! I'm a senior Engineering major at [Harvey Mudd](https://www.hmc.edu/) with an emphasis on mechatronics, mechanical design, and a heavy interest in biomimetics. I've been a clinic engineer at [AirMyne](https://www.airmyne.com/) where I did research regarding interfacial structure design to facilitate the absorption rate of CO2 in the atmosphere. I'm currently doing fluid dynamics research regarding fin motion at the [Harvey Mudd FILM Lab](https://sites.google.com/g.hmc.edu/flow-imaging-lab/home) and a mechatronics engineer under [Blue Origin](https://www.blueorigin.com/). In my free time, I could be working on a variety of personal mechanical/microcontroller projects, creating art, playing videogames, or rock climbing. Stay curious!
